verdict.rationale: Checking the status of a filing, application, or case is a fair question for a state employment agency, so the axis applies. The open esd.wa.gov pages only offer guidance: how to file, appeal, or request penalty waivers. Nothing in the evidence describes a public status-lookup page, and the transactional employer host sits entirely behind a SecureAccess Washington login (probe-4). Even inside EAMS/eServices, the evidence mentions managing tasks and amending reports but never checking the status of a filing or case.
